_comment: Non-secret dev object-storage settings for pier photos (D-19). No credentials here — the catalog identity's access/secret key comes from S3_ACCESS_KEY/S3_SECRET_KEY (.env), applied by the storage-init one-shot container via `weed shell s3.configure`, never committed. This file documents the same settings applied by storage/storage-init in deploy/docker-compose.yml and doubles as the portable AWS-style policy for a real S3-compatible bucket in prod (Flagged Assumptions).
